# MrBikeBD - Bangladesh's #1 Motorcycle Ecosystem

MrBikeBD is the most trusted platform for motorcycle enthusiasts in Bangladesh. It provides comprehensive bike specifications, real-time pricing, expert reviews, and a vibrant marketplace for used motorcycles.

## Core Features
- **Bike Catalog**: Detailed specs, mileage, and prices for all brands in Bangladesh (Yamaha, Honda, Suzuki, etc.).
- **News & Reviews**: Latest motorcycle news, launch updates, and professional expert reviews.
- **Used Marketplace**: A verified marketplace for buying and selling second-hand motorcycles with document verification.
- **EMI Calculator**: Accurate EMI estimations based on current bank interest rates in Bangladesh.
- **Comparison Tool**: Side-by-side comparison of up to 3 motorcycles.

## API & Integration
The platform uses a Next.js frontend with Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) and a Django REST Framework backend.

## SEO & Accessibility
- **ISR**: Core content pages (/bike, /news, /used-bike) are pre-rendered server-side for maximum indexability.
- **Structured Data**: Implements JSON-LD (Product, Article, Breadcrumb) for rich search results.
- **Sitemap**: Dynamic sitemap available at /sitemap.xml.
